notes: Q/P are maintained in one combined always block (both clocks plus reset edges), so there is no cross-block race. The block does reads before writes at a simultaneous edge. Helper registers use non-blocking assignments, so each assertion sees the pre-edge model state: the head before the pop and N before the write. The P-clear edge is S+3, with S = max(2, PARA_AFIFO_CELL_TYPE). That mapping from cell type to stage count is my assumption, and it gives 5 for the default. P is cleared after the check at that edge, which is the lenient reading. CHK-006 has two assertions, one per clock domain. They share the fails_CHK_006 and hits_CHK_006 counters, so Verilator may warn about multiple drivers.
